description: Frozen deterministic post-processing for S1 structured evidence.

ordered_rules.if: real_person == yes AND support_surface == abnormal_non_rest_surface AND torso_pelvis_state == lying AND active_nonlying_support == no

unknown_policy: Any unresolved key evidence yields uncertain; never coerce unknown to negative.
gt_uncertain_policy: Exclude GT uncertain from TP/FP/TN/FN and report prediction distribution separately.
